scientific_integrity: Exact all-size proof supplied; independent finite rational state enumeration corroborates selected orders and parameters; no independent audit.
scientific_limitations: One vaccinated vertex on an unweighted path; uniformly selected seed from the unvaccinated vertices; independently open edges with common parameter; cannot extrapolate to heterogeneous, continuous-time or arbitrary-graph epidemics. Originality remains subject to independent bibliographic review.
title: Universal separation of mean and first-transmission vaccination targets on paths
